messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up to the postmortem for the missing spans + bad aggregation incident. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-5842. Need owners, short timelines, and a persistent regression check.
diego: I can take the aggregation correctness fixes. Plan: add unit tests for the new group-by logic, add null-handling cases, and a small integration test against staging. ETA: Thursday.
anya: I'll investigate the ETL lag root cause (partition skew + compaction issue) and run a targeted backfill for affected ranges. Est backfill time ~4h, will post rows processed.
sylvie: Please create obs-remediations tickets, tag postmortem:INC-5842, and set quick fix vs long-term fix labels. We should have owners by EOD.
diego: Quick validation query I'll run after fixes:
```sql
-- validate counts pre/post for service_x on 2026-03-19
SELECT hour_bucket, COUNT(*) as span_count
FROM spans_agg
WHERE service = 'service_x' AND start_ts >= '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY hour_bucket
ORDER BY hour_bucket;
```
Will diff against raw_events counts.
anya: Runbook actions: add steps to force reprocessing of a single partition, and a checklist for partition compaction. Drafting now.
ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-1234: "aggregation-test-coverage" assigned to diego (due 2026-03-26).
ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-1235: "etl-partition-backfill" assigned to anya (due 2026-03-25).
sylvie: We keep seeing this class of bug (3 occurrences in 6 months). Propose a recurring "obs-regression" 30-min review monthly to track patterns and decide structural fixes. Who can commit?
diego: I can join monthly and bring test failure history.
anya: I'll join and bring partition/compaction metrics + cost estimate for backfills.
sylvie: Also: add a daily span-preservation dashboard and a low-noise alert (pager only if >15% drop sustained 30m). Olivia mentioned a weekly span-coverage job — seems sensible.
diego: For CI: add a nightly synthetic trace run that asserts >=99.95% span preservation. If fails, auto-open OBS CI tickets. I'll instrument.
anya: FYI found one hotspot where a compaction job was delayed by 6h; that likely caused the lag. Adding remediation steps and a guardrail to our runbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: assign OBS-1234 and OBS-1235 to the postmortem board and tag with postmortem:INC-5842.
sylvie: Good. Everyone drop a 1-2 bullet summary in the ticket describing scope and blockers by tomorrow noon. I'll schedule 3 weekly check-ins to follow progress. Ping me for any blocker escalations.
diego: Noted. If we need burst GPUs/compute for backfill I'll request dedicated burst capacity from infra and cc sylvie.
anya: Backfill started; posting row counts in ticket.
sylvie: Thanks all, closing thread for now 1
